## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check-data` shows 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] I read my change on the site (Learn, Browse and Explore)

**If you added or changed a concept** ([style guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md#writing-style-please-read)):

- [ ] A first-year student could follow it: no unexplained jargon
- [ ] It has a real-world example from everyday life
- [ ] It has a one-line `remember`
- [ ] Its `prereqs` list only what is really needed first
- [ ] I opened every "Learn more" link
